title: Veer Savarkar's kin confirms 10 mercy pleas, rejects Rahul Gandhi's claims of loyalty to British
description: Savarkar's grandnephew Satyaki made this disclosure in his cross-examination before Special Judge Amol Shinde, during hearing of a criminal defamation case against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for allegedly defaming the Hindutva ideologue by delivering a speech in London.
